name: One Night Ultimate Vampire
summary: One-night social deduction where vampires secretly convert a villager with marks before a single daytime vote to kill a threat.
rules_text: Use 3 more role tiles than players, plus 3 center tiles. Each player gets a secret role tile and a face-down Mark of Clarity. Extra marks go face-down on boards. Dusk: in order Copycat looks at a center role and becomes it, Vampires (Master, Count, Vampire) wake together and place Mark of the Vampire on a non-vampire, Count then places Mark of Fear to block a night action, and other dusk roles assign Disease, Love, Traitor, Assassin marks. Players briefly wake to see their final Mark. Night: remaining roles act in order, with Pickpocket/Gremlin able to move Marks. Special: Master cannot be killed if a fellow vampire voted for him, Diseased makes its voters unable to win, Lovers die together, Traitor only wins if a teammate dies, Assassin wins only if its marked target dies. Day: all discuss openly then simultaneously vote to kill one player; most votes dies. If a vampire dies, vampire team loses, otherwise vampire team wins, with other teams and solo win conditions resolved by who died and marks.
